correctness.rationale: For positive I, averaging d log I gives mean S=delta/beta. Averaging dI and dS yields mean I=(mu/delta)(q-mean p). Averaging d log[p/(1-p)] yields mean I=alpha mean p-eta E(1/p), since normalized delay preserves stationary mean p. The unique interior equilibrium satisfies analogous I*=alpha p*-eta/p* and I*=(mu/delta)(q-p*). Subtraction gives (alpha+mu/delta+eta/(p* mean p))(mean p-p*)=eta(E1/p-1/mean p). The last term equals E[(p-mean p)^2/p]/(mean p)^2>0 for nonconstant p, proving discount; at eta=0 means coincide. Stationary measure extension follows by bounded observables and invariance, not numerical periodic orbit existence. Sympy identity and a rational formula check independently passed.
residual_risks: The theorem is conditional on strictly interior recurrent states; it does not prove cycle existence or global attraction.
The eta=0 boundary gives exact neutrality and the strict sign requires eta>0 and nonconstant vaccination.
